description: US Census County Business Patterns by state (latest year published, all legal forms): number of establishments, paid employees, first-quarter and annual payroll for a state FIPS code, for all industries or one NAICS code (2 to 6 digits). Official US Census Bureau data from its bulk state file. Aggregate counts only, no company names. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

naics.description: Optional NAICS code, 2 to 6 digits, e.g. 54 (professional services) or 541511

state.description: 2-digit state FIPS code, e.g. 06 for California
